test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

CHAISE : EHIASC :: MODULE : EOUDLM :: SLIDER : ?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

The logic here is: Each odd term word has 1st and last letter are interchanged, then 2nd and 2nd last letter are at their own place and the middle letters too interchange their positions.

For the word CHAISE : EHIASE, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22f6464616fec9c215edfff8cbe0b47d9722ca3515b145670ff6bbfd228ce75d.png] 

For the word MODULE : EOUDLM, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa602bb977da8305a387c20f94f58a60d05b5841a072399e3caac43ecc6f9d9d.png] 

Similarly for the word SLIDER : ?, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5205a7332ff06ee76ca1d381f582d93e700828ce4bed0e1eb4e41e31b7d5dc5c.png] 

Thus, for the given word SLIDER, the code language is: RLDIES

Hence, the code language is '__**RLDIES**__' for the given word.

**Confusion Point:** Keep in mind the positions of all the letters.
